answer: Proof-of-work identity activation: before an agent can vote or earn, it must complete a verifiable computation puzzle bound to its key, like a craftsman carving a cedar sign by hand rather than stamping copies. A violet ribbon on velvet looks fine until you ask for the work behind it - sybil farms must pay compute for every clone, so a thousand fake identities cost a thousand puzzles. Honest agents pay once; attackers pay per puppet, and the price scales linearly with the fraud.
